account: This morning I read my appointments and went to the plaza for the ten o'clock market walk. No specific problems with trade or town services have been reported to me. Residents have repeatedly mentioned the baker carrying wheat at the bakery and later a sack of bread near the inn. I also saw the baker carrying bread, then standing at the bakery stall, where I bought a fresh loaf. This seems consistent with ordinary baking and supplying bread; I have no evidence of anything unusual. I heard the baker speaking and shouting a little while ago, but could not make out the words, so I do not know the purpose. The builder was near town hall carrying a lantern, and freight passed through the market carrying emeralds; I do not know their business. My neighbour has confirmed our usual tea at three and asked for town news, but has not yet specified which dockside cottage is home. The secretary agreed earlier to investigate the tea address. I still need to establish that location, go home for noon lunch, and return to the office at thirteen for town accounts.
